content.text:
All 18 rules reviewed and submitted. Summary of our position on the RadialSpark MSA (we are Clear Capital / "Company"):

**Deviations redlined (9)**
- **LOL-CAP** (critical) — mutual cap exists, but the only carve-out is Paragraph 9 (tax/independent-contractor); no confidentiality, indemnity, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud or IP carve-outs, and the basis is SOW-specific fees rather than 12 months'. Added the 12-month basis, an Excluded Claims sentence and payment-obligations clarification.
- **INDEMN** (critical) — Section 7's heading promises indemnification but no indemnity exists; Section 5(c) is a bare non-infringement rep. Inserted our standard Contractor indemnity.
- **T4C** — our convenience right only bites when no SOW is outstanding (i.e. no real exit); Contractor's is 15 days. Moved to 30 days for us with refund, 90 days for Contractor.
- **GOVLAW** — Arizona law plus mandatory USA&M arbitration with no seat; moved to New York law/venue and seated any arbitration in New York County.
- **ASSIGN** — mutual consent requirement with no affiliate/successor carve-out; added it plus a no-change-of-control-trigger confirmation.
- **LICENSE** — Section 4(c) grant runs to Company only, not irrevocable, not transferable; extended to affiliates/contractors and successors.
- **WARRANTY** — no conformance warranty, period or remedy behind a disclaimer; inserted the 90-day fallback warranty and remedy.
- **INSURANCE** (low) — CGL/E&O/workers' comp present but no cyber cover for a vendor holding our data; added USD 2M cyber.
- **TRANSITION** — no data return, deletion or exit assistance; inserted the standard exit paragraph.

**Compliant (9)** — NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, MFN, AUDIT, LD, MINCOMMIT (absent or in our favour); NOSOLICIT (at fallback, general-advertising carve-out worth adding); IP (Works vest in us with a perpetual licence back; payment-conditioned vesting noted); RENEWAL (no auto-renewal; Contractor's uncapped 30-day rate-change right in Section 3(b) noted as a commercial ask).
